prerequisites: Selecting principles, methods, and research-design procedures to solve specific engineering problems.

learning_outcomes.text: Acquires practical skills regarding the operation of machine tools, special devices, analysis of assembly drawings, and preparation of kinematic diagrams for transmissions used in mechanical engineering.
Knows general aspects regarding the use of specific calculation programs for the design of mechanical and mechatronic systems.
Is able to identify and functionally describe visited equipment and technological processes.
Prepares kinematic diagrams for mechanical transmissions observed during practical training.
Applies theoretical concepts to interpret the operation of thermal installations and systems.
Uses drawing and computer-aided design programs for representing diagrams and parts.
Demonstrates responsibility in applying occupational safety and health regulations in a practical environment.
Is able to elaborate the practical report according to requirements, integrating observations and personal documentation.
Demonstrates autonomy in documenting, analyzing, and presenting visited technological processes.

syllabus_topics: Occupational safety, general instructions, specific instructions for the practical workplace, fire safety instructions
Introduction to the fields, specializations, and disciplines of the first year
Discussion of issues within the first-year practical training
Preparation of organizational sketches for the practical activity location. Presentation of the Faculty
Description of equipment in the sectors where practical activity takes place
Presentation of the main laboratories within the Faculty of Mechanical Engineering
Visit to a production company. Discussions on production lines and at the design workshop
Description of technological processes in the sectors where practical activity takes place
Constructive-functional analysis of technological lines, mechanical transmissions in road vehicle construction, thermal equipment, mechatronic equipment, and robots
Knowledge of main types of mechanical processing
General aspects regarding the use of calculation programs in the design of mechanical and mechatronic systems within the Faculty of Mechanical Engineering
teaching_methods: Practical activities (visits, laboratory work, project work)

assessment_methods.method: Systematic observation of students (individual/team assignments, preparation of a report)
Formative evaluation test (checks during the semester)

assessment_rules: The result of the final evaluation for a discipline is obtained by considering the scores and weights allocated to each activity within the discipline. Integer grades from 1 to 10 will be awarded, with a grade of 5 certifying the achievement of the minimum learning outcomes for a discipline and the granting of corresponding study credits. All laboratory works must be performed, allowing for recovery of only one pending laboratory work.
bibliography: Darabont, A., Pece, St., Occupational Safety, E.D.P., Bucharest, 2000.
institution: Gheorghe Asachi Technical University of Iași
degree: Inginerie Mecanică (licență, 4 ani / 240 ECTS) - Facultatea de Mecanică
